title: mirabilis grandiflora
intro: Mirabilis grandiflora, commonly known as the largeflower beeblossom or royal four o'clock, is a perennial plant in the family Nyctaginaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Mirabilis grandiflora include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as a natural antioxidant, potentially aiding in the prevention of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antipyretic effects.
